name: Alfred
calculationBasis: NET booking revenue — gross GBV minus supplier costs, taxes, and HH processing costs
rate: Tiered monthly: 30% (1–100 bookings), 40% (101–500), 50% (501+). Annual GBV uplift: 60% on portion above €1M; 65% retroactive on all bookings once €5M reached.
setupFee: €4,500 — 50% at signature, 50% at go-live; reimbursed if GBV ≥ €1M in Year 1
minimum: €1,350/month floor from Month 4 (3-layer waterfall: Alfred commission cut → zero → Layer 3 shortfall invoice to Alfred)
deposit: €4,050 quarterly security deposit from Q2; waived after one clean quarter
settlementCadence: Monthly statement within 5 business days of month-end; payment within 14 days; disputes within 5 business days
invoicing: Move issues monthly statement; Layer 3 shortfalls invoiced separately to Alfred
cancellations: HH handles as MoR; GBV net of cancellations; prior revenue share clawed back in next settlement
currency: EUR. AUD bookings converted at ECB mid-market rate on booking confirmation date — rate and date must be stored per booking
term: 12 months auto-renew; Alfred locked in Year 1 (60-day non-renewal window)
